character.name: Bram Malkyr
character.background: Fallen paladin of a disgraced noble house, falsely convicted of treason
traits: Stoic and unflinching even in the face of extreme hardship
Painfully honest, refuses to lie even when deception would save his life
Haunted by guilt over his broken sacred oath, though he knows he was framed
Relentlessly driven to clear his tarnished name and punish those who betrayed him
character.gear: Weathered chain mail · Notched longsword · Rusted Malkyr crest shield · 3 dried venison rations · Tarnished Argent Oath holy symbol · 50 ft hempen rope · Iron tinderbox
character.story: Bram Malkyr, once a knight of the Argent Oath, was framed for treason by a rival lord, stripped of his title, divine favor, and honor. The ritual used to break his oath severed his connection to the gods, and he carries the guilt of that failure every day. He wanders the blighted fringes of the realm, hunting proof of the conspiracy, determined to restore the Malkyr name or burn the kingdom down to find his vengeance.

inventory.name: Notched Longsword
inventory.lore: Passed down through three generations of Malkyr knights, this blade has notched itself on raider armor, cultist bone, and the shield of the traitor who framed Bram. It is the last physical remnant of his family's legacy.
inventory.description: A well-worn steel longsword, its edge still sharp despite decades of use.

inventory.name: Weathered Chain Mail
inventory.lore: Forged for Bram's grandfather, this dented chain mail bears a faint, scorched sigil of the dark ritual that framed Bram. It has protected Malkyr knights for a century, and still holds strong against blade and tooth.
inventory.description: Dented steel chain mail, dark with age and grime.

inventory.name: Rusted Malkyr Crest Shield
inventory.lore: The steel of this heater shield is pitted with rust, and the wyvern crest of House Malkyr is half-scoured away by the ritual's corrupting magic. Bram carries it as a reminder of the betrayal that destroyed his house.
inventory.description: A dented iron shield, its painted wyvern crest almost entirely worn away.

inventory.name: Dried Venison Rations
inventory.lore: These rations were packed by Bram's loyal squire the night before his arrest, the last gift he received from someone who still believed in his innocence.
inventory.description: Tough, dried strips of venison, still edible.

inventory.name: Tarnished Argent Oath Holy Symbol
inventory.lore: Once a blazing beacon of divine power, this silver holy symbol is now dull and cold, its magic severed the moment Bram was framed for betraying his oath. He keeps it as a reminder of what he lost, and what he will reclaim.
inventory.description: A tarnished silver disc etched with the symbol of the Argent Oath, now dark and unresponsive to prayer.
inventory.effects: Glows with faint pale silver light when undead or fiends are within 30 feet, though it grants no other power.

inventory.name: Hempen Rope (50 ft)
inventory.lore: This frayed rope was used to lower Bram into the sunken catacombs where he first uncovered proof of the conspiracy against him. The end is still singed from the torch he dropped when he was ambushed by cultists.
inventory.description: Coiled hempen rope, frayed at one end and stained with mud.

inventory.name: Iron Tinderbox
inventory.lore: Taken from a raider camp Bram raided while exiled, this tinderbox has started hundreds of campfires in the cold, damp nights of his wandering.
inventory.description: A simple iron tinderbox with flint and steel, slightly dented from use.

inventory.name: 50 ft hempen rope
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
